sourceEditorialReview.notes: Controller read all22 move rationales, every accepted and rejected candidate, and every context. Explanations identify the particular sequence/order, method, agency, origin/change, prediction or inquiry inference and source qualification, without interchangeable no-tag templates. This release authenticates a complete independent review, not final approval of proposed labels. Interpretation of analogy versus equivocation, deficient support versus circularity, origin scope versus diversion, and prediction uncertainty versus cognitive bias is reserved for the required fresh anonymous adjudicator; all serious candidates remain in the union. No scores or other reviewer material were exposed.
